selected_script.angle: Deep knife gouges in soft boards trapping food residue vs. hygienic non-porous stainless steel that wipes clean
selected_script.hook: Look closely at the deep knife scratches on your old cutting board—they're trapping hidden food residue.

script_record.pain_point: Deep knife scratches on old cutting boards trap food residue and bacteria that sponges can't reach.
script_record.conflict_hook: A close-up of a sponge scrubbing hard over dark, scarred knife grooves on a stained board, unable to clean the trapped dirt.
script_record.product_solution: Introduce the silver, non-porous stainless steel chopping board, showing meat being sliced cleanly on its pristine metal surface.
script_record.fast_cut_1: Water rinsing over the smooth brushed steel surface, instantly washing away all juices and residue with no stains left behind.
script_record.fast_cut_2: A chef's knife slicing crisp vegetables on the flat board, showcasing the 1 cm downward-folded lip gripping the counter edge securely.
script_record.fast_cut_3: A quick, effortless wipe with a damp cloth, leaving the metallic silver surface spotless and hygienic.
script_record.cta: Upgrade to a cleaner kitchen today.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video with a realistic 9:16 handheld phone-shot aesthetic. Timeline: 0-3s: Show a close-up of a sponge failing to clean deep, dark knife scratches on a dirty old cutting board. 3-6s: Replace it with a silver, flat rectangular stainless steel chopping board (with rounded corners, a slim rigid profile, and one long front edge bent downward into a 1-cm vertical lip wrapping the counter edge) as meat is sliced smoothly on its clean metal surface. 6-10s: Show a quick rinse under running tap water, with all food residue easily sliding off the smooth brushed metal surface, leaving it spotless. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA in this segment. Use the provided product reference images as the exact product identity. Do not change the shape, add feet, handles, or deep grooves. Use the detail and side reference image to preserve product material and the 1 cm bent edge shape.
